name: io.github.WYRE-AI/prtg-mcp
title: PRTG
description: MCP server for Paessler PRTG's REST API v2 - network/infrastructure monitoring for MSPs.

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PRTG API key (Bearer token, generated in the PRTG web UI under Account Settings -> My Account -> API Keys).

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the PRTG core server this connector talks to, e.g. https://prtg.example.com. Every PRTG instance is self-hosted; there is no shared hosted endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
